sections.eyebrow: The Real Reason You Feel Off
sections.headline: Modern Kidney & Bladder Wellness May Be Falling Short
sections.body: Today's lifestyle — processed foods, chronic stress, and environmental exposures — can quietly impact the body's natural kidney and urinary balance. Many adults over 35 don't get enough beneficial plant compounds from their diet alone, making it harder to stay resilient. The result? Low energy, occasional urinary discomfort, and that familiar feeling of being slower or heavier than before. It may not be age alone — it may be what your body is missing.
bullets: Processed diets can reduce beneficial plant compound intake
Stress and environmental factors may disrupt urinary and hormonal balance
Low energy and discomfort may signal your body needs more support

sections.headline: The Ancient Seed Backed by Centuries of Use
sections.body: Often called "Nature's Bladder Guardian," pumpkin seed oil has been used for generations to support urinary health and hormonal balance. Its key natural compounds — beta-sitosterol and zinc — have been studied for their ability to support healthy urinary flow, promote hormonal balance, and encourage thicker-looking hair. Lumora harnesses cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil blended with saw palmetto to help your body maintain its natural daily rhythm.
bullets: Beta-sitosterol supports urinary comfort and hormonal balance
Zinc promotes healthy cellular function and hair follicle strength
Omega 3-6-9 fatty acids support a healthy inflammatory response

sections.body: Lumora keeps it simple — cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil (Cucurbita pepo) blended with saw palmetto extract. No complicated ingredient lists. No fillers or artificial additives. faqs.question: Where can I buy Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil?
faqs.answer: Lumora is available exclusively through our official website. This allows us to maintain the highest quality, freshness, and best pricing directly for our customers.

faqs.question: What ingredients are in Lumora?
faqs.answer: Each softgel contains cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil (Cucurbita pepo) blended with saw palmetto extract. That's it — no fillers, artificial additives, or preservatives.

faqs.question: Is Lumora safe to take alongside my current medications?
faqs.answer: Lumora is formulated with natural, plant-based ingredients generally considered safe for daily adult use. If you take medications or have existing health conditions, please consult your healthcare provider before starting any new supplement.

faqs.question: How soon might I notice a difference?
faqs.answer: Many customers notice calmer urinary function and steadier energy within the first few days or weeks of consistent use. As with any natural supplement, daily use over time provides the best long-term support.

faqs.question: How do I take Lumora?
faqs.answer: Take 2 softgels daily with food, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Each pouch contains 180 softgels — a 2 to 3 month supply depending on your daily use. Consistency delivers the best results.

faqs.question: What if Lumora doesn't work for me?
faqs.answer: If you're not satisfied for any reason, contact us within 30 days of receiving your order. Our team will assist you with a return, replacement, or full refund — your experience and satisfaction come first.
